card.name: Partway through names before a hyphen
card.fires_on: The last piece of a name or word just before a hyphen, such as the 'in' of interleukin before '-1' or '-2', or ' al' before '-Sayyid'. Also seen inside place and transliterated names.

modes.label: Interleukin before number
modes.description: The 'in' ending interleukin, right before a hyphen and a number.
modes.example: Concurrent administration of anakinra (an interleuk<<in>>-1 antagonist) and another TNF

modes.label: Name pieces before hyphen
modes.description: Part of a transliterated or place name, before a hyphen or the rest of the name.

card.plain: It fires on the unfinished end of a name like interleukin when a hyphen and number come next.
